services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: Looking to maximize your results and achieve your personal goals? We have a variety of personal training options. Fill out the form below and we'll get in touch with you to discuss your goals and training opportunities! I have a special place in my heart for people who really want to do the thing, but are nervous about jumping into group classes. As a trainer I specializes in working with folks who are timid about group fitness, have self-doubts about their ability to jump into CrossFit classes, or struggle with exercise. blurb: CrossFit Knoxville's mission is to help educate, motivate and inspire its members to health & fitness goals beyond even their own expectations. We strive to do this by providing professional coaching in an inclusive, caring, fun & energetic environment. We want to meet all people where they are on their fitness journey. Whether it be their first day or an experienced elite level athlete.
